SELECT SUM(a.transaction_amount) AS sumMoney,to_char(a.write_off_date, 'yyyy-mm月') AS depositTIME FROM ( SELECT cc.contract_id, ct.transaction_id, cc.contract_amount, bp.bp_id, ccc.cashflow_id, cc.contract_number, cc.contract_name, bp.bp_name, ccc.due_amount, to_char(cwo.write_off_date,'yyyymm') , cwo.write_off_date, -- ccc.due_amount - ccc.received_amount AS left_amount, ct.transaction_amount - nvl(ct.write_off_amount, 0) AS left_amount, ct.transaction_amount, nvl(ct.write_off_amount, 0) AS write_off_amount, ct.bank_slip_num FROM csh_write_off cwo, csh_transaction ct, con_contract_cashflow ccc, con_contract cc, hls_bp_master bp WHERE ct.transaction_id = cwo.subsequent_csh_trx_id AND cwo.write_off_date >#{tempDate} AND cwo.contract_id = ccc.contract_id AND cwo.cf_item = ccc.cf_item AND cwo.cashflow_id = ccc.cashflow_id AND cwo.contract_id = cc.contract_id AND ct.bp_id = bp.bp_id AND ct.company_id = #{companyId} AND ct.business_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ccc.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' -- AND cwo.write_off_type = -- 'DEPOSIT_CREDIT' AND cwo.write_off_type = 'RECEIPT_DEPOSIT' AND ( ( bp.bp_name LIKE concat(concat('%',#{bp_name}),'%') OR bp.bp_code LIKE concat(concat('%',#{bp_name}),'%') ) OR ( bp.bp_name IS NULL AND bp.bp_code IS NULL ) ) AND ( ( cc.contract_name LIKE concat(concat('%',#{contract_name}),'%') OR cc.contract_number LIKE concat(concat('%',#{contract_name}),'%') ) OR ( cc.contract_name IS NULL AND cc.contract_number IS NULL ) ) ) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM csh_transaction t WHERE t.transaction_type = 'REFUND' AND t.business_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND t.reversed_flag = 'N' ) b ON a.transaction_id = b.source_doc_id GROUP BY write_off_date ORDER BY write_off_date

select t.quarter_n as num, SUM(t.transaction_amount) as sumMoney from ( select
ceil((ABS(
period_diff(to_char(sysdate,'yyyymm'), to_char(ct.transaction_date,'yyyymm'))
)+1 ) / (1*#{n})) as quarter_n, nvl(ct.transaction_amount,0) as transaction_amount from csh_write_off cwo, con_contract_cashflow ccc, con_contract cc, csh_transaction ct where cwo.write_off_type = 'RECEIPT_DEPOSIT' AND cwo.contract_id = cc.contract_id AND cwo.cashflow_id = ccc.cashflow_id AND cwo.subsequent_csh_trx_id =ct.transaction_id AND ct.business_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ct.transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ct.company_id = #{companyId} AND ct.transaction_date <= sysdate and CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(ct.transaction_date),'-'),MONTH(ct.transaction_date)) >= CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(#{n6}),'-'),MONTH(#{n6})) ) t group by t.quarter_n

select t.quarter_n as num, SUM(t.transaction_amount) as sumMoney from ( SELECT ceil((ABS(period_diff(to_char(sysdate,'yyyymm'), to_char(ct.transaction_date,'yyyymm')))+1 ) / (1*#{n})) as quarter_n, nvl(ct.transaction_amount,0) as transaction_amount FROM csh_transaction ct, hls_bp_master bp WHERE ct.business_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ct.transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT_POOL' AND bp.bp_id = ct.bp_id AND ct.company_id = #{companyId} AND ct.transaction_date <= sysdate AND CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(ct.transaction_date),'-'),MONTH(ct.transaction_date)) >= CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(#{n6} ),'-'),MONTH(#{n6} )) ) t group by t.quarter_n

select (SELECT sum(nvl(ct.transaction_amount,0) - nvl(ct.write_off_amount, 0)) AS left_amount FROM csh_transaction ct WHERE ct.business_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ct.transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ct.company_id = #{companyId} AND CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(ct.transaction_date),'-'),MONTH(ct.transaction_date)) <= CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(#{n5} ),'-'),MONTH(#{n5} ))
) as sumMoney1, (SELECT sum(nvl(ct.transaction_amount,0) - nvl(ct.write_off_amount, 0)) AS left_amount FROM csh_transaction ct WHERE ct.business_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ct.transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(ct.transaction_date),'-'),MONTH(ct.transaction_date)) <= CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(#{n4} ),'-'),MONTH(#{n4} )) AND ct.company_id = #{companyId} ) as sumMoney2, (SELECT sum(nvl(ct.transaction_amount,0) - nvl(ct.write_off_amount, 0)) AS left_amount FROM csh_transaction ct WHERE ct.business_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ct.transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(ct.transaction_date),'-'),MONTH(ct.transaction_date)) <= CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(#{n3} ),'-'),MONTH(#{n3} )) AND ct.company_id = #{companyId} ) as sumMoney3, (SELECT sum(nvl(ct.transaction_amount,0) - nvl(ct.write_off_amount, 0)) AS left_amount FROM csh_transaction ct WHERE ct.business_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ct.transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(ct.transaction_date),'-'),MONTH(ct.transaction_date)) <= CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(#{n2} ),'-'),MONTH(#{n2} )) AND ct.company_id = #{companyId} ) as sumMoney4, (SELECT sum(nvl(ct.transaction_amount,0) - nvl(ct.write_off_amount, 0)) AS left_amount FROM csh_transaction ct WHERE ct.business_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ct.transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(ct.transaction_date),'-'),MONTH(ct.transaction_date)) <= CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(#{n1} ),'-'),MONTH(#{n1} )) AND ct.company_id = #{companyId} ) as sumMoney5, (SELECT sum(nvl(ct.transaction_amount,0) - nvl(ct.write_off_amount, 0)) AS left_amount FROM csh_transaction ct WHERE ct.business_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ct.transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ct.transaction_date <= sysdate AND ct.company_id = #{companyId} ) as sumMoney6 from dual

select (SELECT sum(nvl(ct.transaction_amount,0) - nvl(ct.write_off_amount, 0)) AS left_amount FROM csh_transaction ct WHERE ct.business_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ct.transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT_POOL' AND ct.company_id = #{companyId} AND CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(ct.transaction_date),'-'),MONTH(ct.transaction_date)) <= CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(#{n5} ),'-'),MONTH(#{n5} ))
) as sumMoney1, (SELECT sum(nvl(ct.transaction_amount,0) - nvl(ct.write_off_amount, 0)) AS left_amount FROM csh_transaction ct WHERE ct.business_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ct.transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT_POOL' AND CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(ct.transaction_date),'-'),MONTH(ct.transaction_date)) <= CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(#{n4} ),'-'),MONTH(#{n4} )) AND ct.company_id = #{companyId} ) as sumMoney2, (SELECT sum(nvl(ct.transaction_amount,0) - nvl(ct.write_off_amount, 0)) AS left_amount FROM csh_transaction ct WHERE ct.business_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ct.transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT_POOL' AND CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(ct.transaction_date),'-'),MONTH(ct.transaction_date)) <= CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(#{n3} ),'-'),MONTH(#{n3} )) AND ct.company_id = #{companyId} ) as sumMoney3, (SELECT sum(nvl(ct.transaction_amount,0) - nvl(ct.write_off_amount, 0)) AS left_amount FROM csh_transaction ct WHERE ct.business_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ct.transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT_POOL' AND CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(ct.transaction_date),'-'),MONTH(ct.transaction_date)) <= CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(#{n2} ),'-'),MONTH(#{n2} )) AND ct.company_id = #{companyId} ) as sumMoney4, (SELECT sum(nvl(ct.transaction_amount,0) - nvl(ct.write_off_amount, 0)) AS left_amount FROM csh_transaction ct WHERE ct.business_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ct.transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT_POOL' AND CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(ct.transaction_date),'-'),MONTH(ct.transaction_date)) <= CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(#{n1} ),'-'),MONTH(#{n1} )) AND ct.company_id = #{companyId} ) as sumMoney5, (SELECT sum(nvl(ct.transaction_amount,0) - nvl(ct.write_off_amount, 0)) AS left_amount FROM csh_transaction ct WHERE ct.business_type = 'DEPOSIT' AND ct.transaction_type = 'DEPOSIT_POOL' AND ct.transaction_date <= sysdate AND ct.company_id = #{companyId} ) as sumMoney6 from dual

select con.*, nvl(( select sum(d.deduction_amount) from csh_deposit_deduction d, csh_deposit_deduction_hd hd where hd.transaction_id=con.transaction_id and d.deposit_deduction_hd_id=hd.deposit_deduction_hd_id and hd.deposit_status in('NEW', 'APPROVING', 'REJECTED', 'APPROVED_RETURN')),0) + nvl( ( select sum(dr.refund_amount) from csh_deposit_refund dr where dr.transaction_id= con.transaction_id and dr.refund_status!='APPROVED'),0) -nvl(con.left_amount,0) deposit_left_amount from ( select distinct fc.company_id, fc.contract_id, fc.contract_name, fc.contract_number, fc.approval_number, 'FCT_CONTRACT' cashflow_type, hbmt.bp_name, hbmt.bp_code, fpb.bp_id, ct.transaction_id, (ct.transaction_amount-ct.write_off_amount-nvl( ( select nvl(sum(c.due_amount),0)-nvl(sum (c.received_amount),0) from fct_quotation_cashflow c where c.cf_item=14 and c.contract_id=fc.contract_id),0)) as left_amount from fct_contract fc join fct_quotation_cashflow fqc on fc.contract_id=fqc.contract_id and fqc.cf_item=52 join csh_transaction ct on ct.source_doc_line_id=fqc.quotation_cashflow_id and ct.business_type='DEPOSIT' and ct.transaction_type='DEPOSIT' and ct.source_doc_category='FCT_CONTRACT' left join fct_project_bp fpb on fpb.project_id = fc.project_id and fpb.credit_grantor_party = 'Y' -- and fpb.repay_guarantee_party != 'Y' left join hls_bp_master hbmt on fpb.bp_id = hbmt.bp_id where fc.data_class='NORMAL' and fc.contract_status not in ('END', 'TERMINATE') and nvl(fqc.due_amount,0)-nvl(fqc.received_amount,0) >0 union select distinct cc.company_id, cc.contract_id, cc.contract_name, cc.contract_number, pp.approval_number, 'CON_CONTRACT' cashflow_type, hbmt.bp_name, hbmt.bp_code, cc.tenant_id as bp_id, ct.transaction_id, (ct.transaction_amount-ct.write_off_amount-nvl( ( select nvl(sum(c.due_amount),0)-nvl(sum (c.received_amount),0) from con_contract_cashflow c where c.cf_item=14 and c.contract_id=cc.contract_id),0)) as left_amount from con_contract cc join prj_project pp on pp.project_id=cc.project_id join con_contract_cashflow ccc on cc.contract_id=ccc.contract_id and ccc.cf_item=52 join csh_transaction ct on ct.source_doc_line_id=ccc.cashflow_id and ct.business_type='DEPOSIT' and ct.transaction_type='DEPOSIT' and ct.source_doc_category='CON_CONTRACT' left join hls_bp_master hbmt on hbmt.bp_id = cc.tenant_id where cc.data_class='NORMAL' and cc.contract_status not in ('END', 'TERMINATE') and nvl(ccc.due_amount,0)-nvl(ccc.received_amount,0)>0 ) con
